desc:
🧹 Clean The Everything! 🧹

🗺️ MORE MAPS: Sort the LIBRARY and the FISH MARKET and CAFE and MORE!
💾 SAVES: Your Items on the floor, your time, your shelves, your whole run!
👍 THUMBS UP for more UPDATES and MAPS👍

🖥️ PC Controls:
E or Click: Pick up / Place item
Q: Throw item
Scroll: Cycle items
Right Click: Zoom In
H: Hint

🎮 Controller Controls:
RT: Pick up / Place item
B: Throw item
RB: Zoom In
LT: Cycle it
D-Pad: Abilities

🧹 The whole place has been turned upside down and there's stuff EVERYWHERE! Roll up your sleeves and clean up the mess by sorting thousands of scattered items into their right spots. Sort books by genre in the Library, fish by size in the Fish Market, and stay tuned for even MORE maps to tidy up!

👥 Clean up alone or with friends. Team up to carry even more!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn Speed, Jump & Carry upgrades plus 5 powerful abilities Reveal, Magnet, Reorder, Auto-Shelf & Scan!
